profiles.shortDescription: optacom develops dimensional surface-measurement systems for industrial quality control. Its documented portfolio covers contour, roughness and roundness measurement.
fullDescription: The manufacturer-owned company page and catalog identify optacom as a German measurement-technology business founded in 1999. Its systems evaluate component contour, surface roughness and roundness for production and inspection applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Optibelt manufactures belt-drive components for industrial power transmission. Its official range includes V-belts, timing belts, ribbed belts, pulleys and related drive elements.
fullDescription: Optibelt's manufacturer-owned product directory documents mechanical power-transmission products for industrial drives. The portfolio spans wrapped and raw-edge V-belts, synchronous and ribbed belts, variable-speed belts, pulleys and matched drive solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Optris develops non-contact infrared temperature-measurement equipment. Its portfolio includes infrared thermometers, thermal imaging cameras and measurement software.
fullDescription: Optris' official product directory documents infrared instrumentation for non-contact temperature measurement in industrial processes. The range combines fixed and portable pyrometers, compact and high-resolution thermal cameras, calibration accessories and analysis software.

profiles.shortDescription: Orange Research manufactures differential-pressure, flow and level instrumentation. Its range includes gauges, switches, transmitters and cryogenic liquid-level instruments.
fullDescription: Orange Research's official site documents mechanical and electronic instruments for monitoring differential pressure, flow and liquid level. Product groups include differential-pressure gauges and switches, flow meters and transmitters, and cryogenic level systems for industrial installations.

profiles.shortDescription: ORBINOX manufactures industrial flow-control equipment. Its official portfolio includes knife-gate valves, penstocks, dampers and engineered valves for hydraulic works.
fullDescription: ORBINOX's manufacturer-owned product directory presents flow-control products for handling liquids, slurries, gases and bulk processes. The documented range covers knife-gate valves, slide gates and penstocks, dampers and special valves used in industrial and water infrastructure.

profiles.shortDescription: ORBIT MERRET develops electronic instruments for measurement and process control. Its portfolio includes panel meters, controllers, recorders, signal converters, displays and position sensors.
fullDescription: ORBIT MERRET's official product directory documents instruments for displaying, recording, converting and controlling industrial signals. The range includes panel meters, paperless recorders, transmitters, large displays, PLC and IoT modules, position transducers, rotary sensors and flow instruments.

profiles.shortDescription: Ortlinghaus develops power-transmission and braking components for industrial machinery. Its product scope includes plates, clutches, brakes, clutch-brake units and engineered mechatronic systems.
fullDescription: Ortlinghaus' official site presents mechanical and mechatronic components that transmit, control and stop rotary motion. The portfolio covers friction plates, hydraulic and electromagnetic clutches, brakes, combined clutch-brake units and application-specific drive systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Osborn manufactures industrial surface-treatment tools and engineered brush products. Its range covers power brushes, roller and strip brushes, polishing tools, compounds and related finishing products.
fullDescription: Osborn's official product directory documents tools for cleaning, deburring, grinding, polishing and surface finishing. Product groups include power and maintenance brushes, roller and strip brushes, polishing tools and compounds, diamond tools and selected idler and cam-follower components.

profiles.shortDescription: OSTELECTRIC is an Italian industrial-brake business acquired by RINGSPANN in 2018. Its documented product heritage covers electrohydraulic disc and drum brakes, thrusters and brake controls.
fullDescription: The legacy manufacturer site and RINGSPANN's official acquisition notice establish OSTELECTRIC's identity and its 2018 integration into the RINGSPANN Group. Current parent-company material continues the electrohydraulic brake scope through disc brakes, drum brakes, thrusters and associated controls.

profiles.shortDescription: P.E. LABELLERS develops industrial labelling machines and integrated packaging-line systems. Its portfolio covers pressure-sensitive, cold-glue, hot-melt, roll-fed and combined labelling technologies.
fullDescription: P.E. LABELLERS' official product directory documents rotary and linear labelling equipment for containers and packaged goods. The range includes self-adhesive, cold-glue, hot-melt and roll-fed systems together with combined machines, shrink applications and digital print-and-apply solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: P.E.I. develops protective systems for machine tools and production equipment. Its portfolio includes telescopic covers, bellows, roll-up covers, aprons and engineered machine guards.
fullDescription: P.E.I.'s official company page and catalog identify an Italian manufacturer founded in 1980 and focused on machine protection. The documented range protects moving axes, guides and working areas through telescopic steel covers, bellows, aprons, roll-up systems, XY shields and safety enclosures.

profiles.shortDescription: PackLab is a P.E. LABELLERS division for linear self-adhesive labelling and print-and-apply systems. Its official range covers label application and variable-data printing for packaging lines.
fullDescription: PackLab's official site identifies the business as part of P.E. LABELLERS and documents linear pressure-sensitive labelling technology. The published portfolio includes modular label applicators, print-and-apply units and integrated systems for applying identification and logistics labels.

profiles.shortDescription: PacSeal Hydraulics develops fluid-power control components for demanding hydraulic systems. Its official product information covers directional-control valves and manifold solutions using ShearFlo sealing technology.
fullDescription: PacSeal Hydraulics' manufacturer-owned site documents high-pressure hydraulic control products built around metal-to-metal ShearFlo sealing. The published range includes SV and SVX directional-control valves, manifold configurations and engineered fluid-power components for severe-service applications.

profiles.shortDescription: PAGO is a Fuji Seal labelling-equipment brand for pressure-sensitive label application. Current parent-company products include modular PAGO labellers and applicators for packaging lines.
fullDescription: Fuji Seal's official product page preserves PAGO as a current machine family within its pressure-sensitive labelling solutions. The documented portfolio includes PAGOmat modular labelers, compact ECO equipment and linear applicators for front, back, wraparound and logistics-label tasks.

profiles.shortDescription: Paladon Systems designs and manufactures valve actuators and control systems. Its portfolio covers pneumatic, hydraulic and electrohydraulic actuation for onshore, offshore and subsea applications.
fullDescription: Paladon Systems' official company brochure documents a valve-automation business established in 1981. Its engineered scope includes quarter-turn and linear actuators, hydraulic power and control packages, emergency shutdown systems and subsea actuation solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Palazzoli manufactures electrical systems for industrial and demanding environments. Its portfolio includes plugs, sockets, interlocked outlets, enclosures, distribution equipment, controls and industrial lighting.
fullDescription: Palazzoli's official product directory documents electrical distribution and connection products for factories, infrastructure and hazardous areas. The range covers industrial plugs and sockets, interlocked switched outlets, boards and boxes, control devices, ATEX equipment and industrial lighting.

profiles.shortDescription: PanBlast supplies equipment and components for abrasive blasting operations. Its documented range includes blast pots, bulk blasting systems, metering valves, nozzles and operator accessories.
fullDescription: PanBlast's manufacturer-owned site and technical resources cover equipment used to store, meter and deliver abrasive media. The portfolio includes portable and bulk blast vessels, control valves, nozzles, hoses, remote controls and supporting equipment for surface-preparation work.

profiles.shortDescription: Panasonic Industry manufactures electronic and automation components for industrial equipment. Its portfolio includes relays, switches, connectors, sensors, controllers, human-machine interfaces and servo systems.
fullDescription: Panasonic Industry's official product portal documents components and systems used in factory automation, equipment control and electronic assemblies. Product groups include relays, connectors, switches, encoders, pressure and measurement sensors, safety devices, PLC and motion controllers, HMIs, vision systems and servo motors.

profiles.shortDescription: Panduit develops electrical and network infrastructure products for industrial and data environments. Its range covers cable routing, connectivity, identification, grounding, enclosures and industrial networking.
fullDescription: Panduit's official product directory documents infrastructure components that organize, connect, protect and identify electrical and data systems. The portfolio includes wire-routing products, copper and fiber connectivity, industrial network components, labels and printers, grounding products, terminals and enclosures.

profiles.shortDescription: Papenmeier is a German technology group with industrial process-observation and electronics businesses. Its documented scope includes Lumiglas sight-glass systems, cameras, lighting and custom electronic development and manufacturing.
fullDescription: Papenmeier's official group site presents businesses in process observation, electronics and assistive technology. For industrial users, the Lumiglas portfolio covers sight-glass fittings, luminaires, cameras and visual-control systems, while Papenmeier Elektronik develops and manufactures custom electronic assemblies.

profiles.shortDescription: Partex manufactures identification systems for wires, cables and industrial components. Its portfolio includes markers, labels, printers, software and cable-installation accessories.
fullDescription: Partex's manufacturer-owned site documents products for identifying electrical wiring, cables, terminals, panels and equipment. The range includes pre-printed and printable markers, labels, thermal-transfer printers, marking software, ferrules, ties and related installation accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Pasaban designs machinery for paper and board converting. Its product range includes sheeters, winders, ream wrappers, unwinders, laminating systems and finishing equipment.
fullDescription: Pasaban's official site documents converting machinery for paper, board and specialty materials. The portfolio covers high-speed sheeting, winding and rewinding, ream wrapping, unwinding, laminating, laser cutting and punching, foil stamping and integrated line automation.

profiles.officialName: Paul Wegner GmbH & Co. KG Maschinenmesserfabrik
profiles.shortDescription: Paul Wegner manufactures industrial machine knives and wear components. Its range includes doctor, creping, coating, sealing, scraper and special-purpose blades.
fullDescription: Paul Wegner's official product portfolio documents precision knives and related components for continuous industrial processes. The manufacturer supplies coating and creping blades, doctor and metering systems, sealing and scraper knives, slitting products and application-specific blade geometries.

profiles.shortDescription: Paus manufactures specialized mobile machinery for mining, tunnelling, construction and industrial transport. Its portfolio includes underground vehicles, loaders, lifting equipment and application-specific carriers.
fullDescription: Paus' official site documents machines for underground mining and tunnelling together with construction, lift and industrial-vehicle products. The range includes personnel and service vehicles, loaders and dumpers, scalers, mobile lifting equipment and engineered machines for confined or demanding operating environments.

profiles.shortDescription: PAYPER develops complete bag-packaging lines for bulk solids. Its systems cover dosing, weighing, bag filling, palletizing, load stabilization and wrapping.
fullDescription: PAYPER's official product directory presents integrated packaging lines for powders, granules and other bulk materials. The documented scope combines weighing and dosing units, open-mouth and valve-bag fillers, form-fill-seal systems, robotic palletizers and stretch-wrapping equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: PBC Linear manufactures linear-motion components and mechatronic assemblies. Its range includes bearings, shafts, guides, lead screws, ball screws, slides and actuators.
fullDescription: PBC Linear's official product directory documents mechanical and electromechanical products for guided linear movement. The portfolio covers plain and ball-based linear bearings, precision shafts and rails, lead-screw and ball-screw assemblies, linear slides, actuators and integrated mechatronic systems.

profiles.shortDescription: PEG is a Rossi & Kramer machinery brand for rebuilding internal-combustion-engine components. Its range includes valve-seat machines, valve refacers and related cylinder-head workshop equipment.
fullDescription: PEG's official site traces the machinery brand to 1968 and presents it within Rossi & Kramer's engine-reconditioning portfolio. Documented products include valve-seat grinding and boring machines, valve-guide equipment, valve refacers, manual cutters and tools for cylinder-head repair.

profiles.shortDescription: Peinemann Equipment develops machinery for maintaining shell-and-tube heat exchangers. Its range includes tube-bundle extractors, bundle cleaners, tube cleaners and dome-cleaning systems.
fullDescription: Peinemann Equipment's official product directory documents machines that remove, handle and clean heat-exchanger tube bundles and individual tubes. The portfolio includes bundle extractors and lifters, external and internal cleaning systems, dome cleaners and special engineered maintenance equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Pekos manufactures industrial ball valves for flow-control applications. Its range includes floating, trunnion-mounted, multiway, top-entry, cryogenic and metal-seated designs.
fullDescription: Pekos' official site and catalog document ball valves built to major industrial pressure and flange standards. The portfolio covers two-piece and three-piece floating valves, trunnion-mounted valves, multiway and top-entry configurations, cryogenic service and metal-seated variants.

profiles.shortDescription: Penny & Giles is a Curtiss-Wright legacy brand for position sensing and human-machine control products. Its documented portfolio includes joysticks, linear and rotary sensors, transducers, faders and solenoid actuators.
fullDescription: Curtiss-Wright's official legacy-brand page identifies Penny & Giles as a controls business founded in 1956 and acquired in 2002. The documented product heritage covers joysticks, rotary and linear position sensors, LVDT and RVDT transducers, studio faders, panel meters and solenoid actuators.

profiles.shortDescription: LAMBDA develops peristaltic pumps for laboratory and process dosing. Its range spans compact single-channel pumps through multi-channel and high-flow liquid-transfer systems.
fullDescription: LAMBDA's official pump directory documents peristaltic equipment for controlled liquid feeding, transfer and continuous dosing. The product family includes PRECIFLOW, MULTIFLOW, HiFLOW, MAXIFLOW and MEGAFLOW pumps for laboratory, fermentation and small-process applications.

profiles.shortDescription: perma develops automatic lubrication systems for industrial equipment. Its portfolio covers single-point and multi-point lubricators with mechanical, electromechanical and connected control options.
fullDescription: perma's official site documents automatic lubrication systems that deliver measured lubricant quantities to bearings, chains, motors and other machine points. The range spans compact disposable lubricators, refillable electromechanical units and multi-point systems with remote monitoring options.

profiles.shortDescription: PERRIN manufactures industrial ball valves within the KITZ Group. Its product range covers standard, multiway, top-entry, cryogenic, hydrogen and application-specific valve designs.
fullDescription: PERRIN's official product directory documents ball-valve technology for demanding industrial media and operating conditions. The portfolio includes two-way and multiway valves, top-entry constructions, cryogenic and hydrogen-service designs, metal-seated solutions and engineered special valves.

profiles.shortDescription: PETER electronic develops electronic controls for starting, stopping and regulating electric drives. Its portfolio includes soft starters, motor brakes, frequency converters and DC motor controllers.
fullDescription: PETER electronic's official product directory documents control equipment for asynchronous and DC motors. The range includes soft starters, direct-current injection brakes, combined starting and braking units, variable-frequency drives, DC controllers and safety-related modules.

profiles.shortDescription: Petersime develops incubation and hatchery systems for poultry production. Its portfolio includes incubators, hatchers, climate-control equipment, hatchery automation and management software.
fullDescription: Petersime's official site documents equipment and digital systems for poultry incubation and hatchery operation. The range combines single-stage and conventional incubators, hatchers, climate-control systems, automation, monitoring software and complete hatchery project solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: PETKUS develops machinery and complete plants for seed and grain processing. Its portfolio covers cleaning, sorting, drying, conveying, treatment, storage and plant automation.
fullDescription: PETKUS' official technology directory documents equipment and integrated systems for seed, grain and food-processing operations. The portfolio includes intake and conveying, cleaners and separators, optical sorting, drying, seed treatment, storage, laboratory equipment and automated complete plants.

profiles.shortDescription: pewag manufactures chain systems for mobility, lifting and industrial applications. Its range includes traction chains, forestry chains, lifting products, conveyor chains and tyre-protection systems.
fullDescription: pewag's official site and catalog portal document chain-based products for transportation, forestry, lifting and industrial material handling. The portfolio covers snow and traction chains, forestry tracks and chains, lifting chains and components, conveyor and hoist chains, and tyre-protection chains.

profiles.shortDescription: Pfeuffer develops sampling and analysis equipment for grain and seed quality control. Its portfolio includes samplers, dividers, moisture meters, laboratory instruments and silo-monitoring systems.
fullDescription: Pfeuffer's manufacturer-owned site documents equipment for obtaining, preparing and evaluating representative grain and seed samples. Product groups include manual and automatic samplers, sample dividers, cleaners and mills, moisture and quality instruments, and temperature-monitoring systems for storage silos.
